channel.title: The Lowndes Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lowndes Signal (lowndessignal.com)

item.title: Two men arrested for Lowndes County cattle theft
item.description: Two men charged with first-degree theft are accused of stealing $40,000 in cattle from Lowndes County farms; one remains jailed as deputies seek tips on other missing cows.

item.title: When texting is their love language
item.description: Overwhelmed by constant texts from someone you like? Amy explains why it's a communication-style mismatch, how to set boundaries and what their response reveals about compatibility.

item.title: Davis takes athlete contest in landslide victory
item.description: Central High senior guard Jerdarius Davis is named Lowndes County Athlete of the Week, earning 64% of 848 votes in round 21 of the 2025-26 season.

item.title: Schools award triple winners in district science fair
item.description: Lowndes County science fair at The Calhoun School names three first-place winners: high schoolers Zanish Drish and Jaida Davis and middle schooler Jabraylan Rush.

item.title: Citizens mobilize to revitalize Fort Deposit
item.description: Fort Deposit’s new mayor, council and residents drive town revitalization with grants, cleanup campaigns and volunteer efforts ahead of the 2026 Calico Fort festival.

item.title: Fight against hopeless emotions
item.description: When life’s worst hits — illness, job loss, divorce — hopelessness can pull you into depression. This piece urges you to fight that emotion and keep believing in tomorrow.

item.title: Calhoun freshman earns CIA award
item.description: Calhoun freshman honored with January Character in Action award after turning in $169 he found on a school bus, recognized for integrity and example to peers.

item.title: Ivey awards $4.5 million to help low-income residents
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey awards $4.5 million in federal grants to 18 Alabama community action agencies to support employment, budgeting and emergency aid programs for low-income residents.

item.title: What's Happening in Lowndes County
item.description: From a Valentine's banquet and runoff election to cleanups, classes and the Calico Fort fair, here's what's happening across Lowndes County in the coming weeks.

item.title: Fort Deposit benefits from SEEDS award
item.description: Fort Deposit to use $102K SEEDS grant, $25.5K match to assess industrial park site, while council also awards nearly $326K drainage project contract.
